## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this change focused and avoided unrelated refactors where practical.

- [ ] I updated documentation and changelogs when the change affects users.
- [ ] I ran the appropriate checks described in `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I called out any breaking changes explicitly.
